Vendored so the hosted app does not depend on a CDN at runtime (pinned versions).
- gif.js 0.2.0 (dist/gif.js, dist/gif.worker.js), MIT per its package.json, by Johan Nordberg. https://github.com/jnordberg/gif.js
- gifuct-js 2.1.2, MIT, see gifuct-js.LICENSE. Bundled to one ES module with js-binary-schema-parser 2.0.3 (MIT, see js-binary-schema-parser.LICENSE).
